items.t: It is one of nine sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock", inside the City of Surrey's South Surrey community.

Transit: TransLink's published timetable for Route 352 (Bridgeport Station / Ocean Park) routes it via 152 St, 16 Ave, 128 St, Crescent Rd and King George Blvd through South Surrey Park & Ride — the Crescent Road corridor through this pocket is a TransLink bus corridor.

Parks and heritage: Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park, 2598 144 Street — a 140-hectare park of second-growth forest with about four kilometres of nature trails, at the sub-area's eastern edge; Elgin Heritage Park and the Stewart Farmhouse at 13723 Crescent Road are City-designated heritage entries (Bylaws 7823 and 12922) on the Nicomekl River, and the City's coming Nicomekl Riverfront Park will run 3 km on the river's south side from Elgin Road to 40 Avenue.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Elgin Chantrell Guide

items.t: SSMUH, suites and coach houses (Surrey-wide): up to 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; one secondary suite per single family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit, never inside a coach house or garden suite, its habitable floor area at most 40% of the principal dwelling unit (no 90 m² cap is current); a coach house or garden suite of 35–75 m², rising to 120 m² for lots zoned RA, R2, R2-O and R3 below maximum FAR, with one extra parking space required.

ALR housing frame: any parcel in the Agricultural Land Reserve follows the ALC frame — one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha). ALR status is a parcel-by-parcel check in the ALC's ALR Property and Map Finder.

blocks.text: Good to know about Elgin Chantrell Guide

items.t: The name is a listing label, not a legal boundary. There is no single City boundary or plan for "Elgin Chantrell," and the board's street-level line is member-only — compare a listing against the actual street and parcel, not the label.

Heritage is a constraint here, not just character. Elgin Heritage Park and the Stewart Farmhouse at 13723 Crescent Road are City-designated heritage entries — a property near the Crescent Road heritage cluster needs its heritage status checked before renovation or subdivision plans are priced.
The RA numbers in older copy are not settled. The coach-house figures that do apply to RA lots (35–75 m², up to 120 m²) are confirmed on the City's coach houses page.

Streets, schools and getting around Elgin Chantrell Townhomes

items.t: Catchments: no School District 36 locator run is on record for this area.

Green space anchors: Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park, 2598 144 St — about 140 hectares with roughly 4 km of trails (City of Surrey). Elgin Heritage Park and the Historic Stewart Farmhouse at 13723 Crescent Road, a designated heritage site (Surrey Heritage Bylaws 7823/12922), and the planned Nicomekl Riverfront Park, about 3 km of riverfront and 80 acres.
Transit: bus route 352 serves the area via Crescent Road (TransLink). There is no SkyTrain service in South Surrey.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Elgin Chantrell Townhomes

items.t: Zoning is under Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000. Much of Elgin Chantrell is Rural Residential (RA) zoning with ALR parcels at the edges.
Wells and septic: RA/ALR parcels in this area can sit on private well and septic systems rather than City water and sewer.

Secondary suites in Surrey are capped at 40% of the principal dwelling's habitable floor area (City of Surrey, secondary suites). Inside a strata townhouse, the strata's bylaws govern whether a suite is possible at all.

SSMUH: Surrey implemented the provincial small-scale multi-unit housing rules on July 8, 2024 — up to 3 units on lots under 280 m², up to 4 units on lots over 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop (City of Surrey, SSMUH). SSMUH applies to eligible single-family lots, not to lots inside an existing strata townhouse complex, and ALR parcels are governed by the ALR rules first.
Short-term rentals: Surrey permits short-term rentals only in the operator's own principal residence, with a City business licence at $358/year as stated on the City's licence page.
Property tax timing: Surrey property taxes are due July 2; a 5% penalty applies to amounts unpaid after July 2 and a further 5% after September 2.

New Housing Rebate (GST/HST): Separate from the first-time buyer rebate: a 36% rebate of the GST on new or substantially renovated housing, to a maximum of $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000 of value.

PTT exemptions: First-time home buyers: full exemption on the first $500,000 of value where the fair market value is $835,000 or less, phasing out to $860,000. Newly built homes: full exemption up to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000.

blocks.text: Good to know about Elgin Chantrell Townhomes

items.t: The Keystone filing split. The same complex, Keystone at 2925 King George Blvd, appears in listings under two different board sub-areas — "Subdivision: Elgin Chantrell" on some, and "Subdivision: King George Corridor" on others. A buyer searching only one sub-area name will miss listings filed under the other.
Three names, one complex. "The Crescent," "Crescent 1" and "The Crescent II" are marketing names for the single strata plan LMS4241 at 3500 144 St — 57 homes, not three complexes.

A 140-hectare forest inside a suburb. Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park (2598 144 St) preserves about 140 hectares of urban forest with roughly 4 km of trails, immediately north of The Crescent's 144 St corridor.

Heritage on Crescent Road. Elgin Heritage Park holds the Historic Stewart Farmhouse at 13723 Crescent Road, a designated heritage property (Surrey Heritage Bylaws 7823/12922), and the City plans a Nicomekl Riverfront Park of about 3 km of riverfront and 80 acres along the river at the area's north edge.
The City has no Elgin Chantrell boundary.
Tax deadline. Surrey taxes are due July 2 with a 5% penalty after July 2 and a further 5% after September 2 — relevant on any summer completion here.
